name: Skill Chain Validator
description: When intent-detector.ts is edited, validates that every TaskType in types.ts has a matching entry in intent-detector, tool-router, and constants

then.prompt:
The TaskType definition was edited. Validate the full skill chain is intact:

1. Read doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/types.ts and extract all TaskType values
2. For each TaskType (except general_chat), verify it exists in:
   - intent-detector.ts INTENT_PATTERNS
   - tool-router.ts INTENT_TO_SKILL
   - constants.ts DEFAULT_MODEL_REGISTRY
3. Report any missing entries and add them if needed

Every TaskType MUST have a complete chain: type → intent pattern → skill mapping → model config. A broken chain means Doraemon can't route messages to that skill.
